_note: Text for the onboarding flow (/start, issue #152), in ASD-STE100. The flow asks a few questions, then the visitor makes one practice wire before sign-up. The answers stay in the browser; only the start project goes to the lobby, in a cookie. The 'build' option values are project slugs from content/projects/.

wire.title: Connect 3V3 to the + line
wire.hole: The glowing hole on the + line
wire.hint: 3V3 is already selected. Tap the glowing hole to finish the wire.
